newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs ease as rate doubts linger.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs ease as rate doubts linger.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese government bond (JGB) futures eased on Thursday in mostly technically driven trade but dealers said growing uncertainty about the Japanese interest rate outlook weighed on the market.
December Euroyen see-sawed in a four-tick range all day, finding good buying interest at its low of 99.00. It was quoted at 99.00 at 1115 GMT against its IMM close at 99.04.
"Everyone in the pit was trying to buy at 99.00 because most of the locals are still short and it's a strong technical support level," a trader with a Japanese futures house said.

"Recently the market has just been sensitive to any comments. People are expecting interest rates to be raised but Japanese banks are still having problems so they shouldn't hike until the second half," he added.
Dealers said there were a fair number of spread trades with players buying December Euroyen and selling March on the belief that interest rates were headed higher in the longer term.
A senior trader with an Asian institution said December Euroyen looked confined to a 99.00-99.08 range, with a break below exposing it to further downside to 98.95.
June JGBs settled at 126.58 against their previous 126.71.
Eurodollar futures ended little changed in thin trade with September at 93.74 against its IMM close at 93.73.
